items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you mentioned your father. His name was Norrell?

ctx.x: . . . I forget, and ask you, just for the record, you mentioned your father. His name was Norrell?
Norrell Wilbur, [spells first name]. Norrell Wilbur Carter, and the Wilbur was W-i­ l-b-u-r.
